reviews.x: The quality of product is very good , in fact better that what I expected , this worked perfect for my daughter , the count is also good so you have plenty of choices available.

If anyone read my review that said these were too tight, I apologize.  That review was for a different set of headbands, which I accidentally put here.  So forthwith is my review for these headbands.  Firstly, they are decidedly not tight. They are really very comfy.  Secondly, they took forever to get here. I ordered them April 24, and they finally arrived on July 23. Talk about a slow boat from China. So if you need them in a hurry, you are out of luck.   I am not convinced that they are very

i would definitely recommend this product. for me, i wear a lot of wigs so the headbands will make them pop. they are very comfortable and not tight at all. as you can tell by the pictures i received all 20 bands and for the price it is most definitely worth your money!  the only thing i didn’t like was they came with a terrible smell but nothing a quick wash in the washing machine can’t fix. and i had let them air dry because i was scared that would shrink.

reviews.t: So many but not too many!
reviews.x: I am glad to get this set although some of them are not my favorite. The patterns are cute with nice materials. Almost always Incan find one that can go with my outfit.

These are mid quality headbands which is what I was looking for. I was worried they were going to be like super cheap and thin but they’re not. You get so many of them and so many cute patterns and colors at a good price. The silky ones slide of my head easy and the more rougher feeling ones stay in place pretty good. I use a couple Bobby pins to help with that because I was have trouble with all headbands sliding off my head. I guess it’s just the shape of my head.

I’m giving this 5 stars, the headbands actually stay on my head! They are comfortable to wear. I workout everyday and these have helped keep my hair back and not once did I have to readjust! They are cute to wear working out or dress up! I was surprised by the quality considering the price! Super great find!
Thought they were cotton. They are polyester and slipped frequently.  I gave some away and everyone commented on the slipping. I dont wear them. Wasted my money.

I really liked all the different colors. However, I did not receive 20 pcs. There were only 16 pcs. Secondly, I am  a 62 year old adult 270 pounds and all head bands fell straight off my head. They are too long and way too loose. So now I have the task of taking them all apart and resizing them all. They definitely stretch bigger but that is of no use too me as they fall straight off my head. Need to be at least 2 inches tighter.

reviews.t: Pretty Selection! Nice Value! Lack Grip
reviews.x: These headbands come in a variety of colors and prints. Very pretty on. I gave 4 stars because unless you have a thick hair texture or big style they will slide back. I wear my hair back in a pony most times and in order for me to keep them on for an extended period of time before having to adjust, I had to use a few bobby-pins to keep it from coming off. I will use them whenever I want a pop of color.

I really like these headbands! My only dislike is they can be a little tight, which is good since they stay. But also bad because I can't wear them all day if i wanted. For the price, they are what I expected and they're super cute, so I would totally get more of these, but pretty set with how many this comes with!

reviews.t: The best selection of headbands on this site IMO
reviews.x: Bought these for someone else and they love them. The quality is great for the price, and the giftee (is this a word?) enjoys being able to switch up her headbands daily/with different outfits.  For those wondering, the material is polyester. It isn’t cotton, velvet, or suedette.

Loved the quality and various prints. The only thing is they were tight on my head. I guess if you head is size 8 or above these are too tight. Caused me to have headaches and they were just uncomfortable after awhile. Gave away to friend with smaller heads.

I use the headbands to help me get through each week. They give me a different look because they ate so colorful.  They do have a tendency to pinch around the ears unless you push the back farther on your head overall a good value for your money.

I have a "big head" so these don't fit comfortably where I want them positioned all day. I put a couple pins in, but by the end of the work day I have to take off. My personal experience, if your head is smaller they are perfect.

reviews.t: More for a child or someone with a small head.
reviews.x: Unfortunately, these headbands were too small for an adult head. Too tight and popped right off. On the plus side, they were very pretty designs and you received quite a few for the money.
These are great they all look like the ones showed in the photo. I think about half a silky and and the other half is a soft textured cotton.  Comfortable and they all look great!

reviews.t: Make sure you check the size
reviews.x: These are so cute, but I do have a big head, so they were kind of tight, I couldn’t take stars away because I should have checked the size a little better, but they are worth it

reviews.t: Good value for money would buy back again
reviews.x: l love these head wrap so comfortable good value for money,beautiful color look amazing with briad I would not say they are thick but easy to put over head and alot stretch.

Nice and affordable pack! Pretty colors that can add pizzazz to my otherwise boring clothes. Need a solid package too! Perhaps more stripes and polka-dots would be nice.
These, I feel are cheaply made. The material was not soft and the fit did not exist.  Slipped right off. I ended up donating these to Goodwill.  Very disappointed.
Great headbands for adults, I have yet to use all the headbands and it's been 3 months. The headbands are stretchy but will stay on all day which I needed.
This was an amazing buy. We received so many beautiful headbands for such a low price! The headbands were great quality too!
Great value for the amount of headbands. They are comfortable, soft and super cute! I’m very happy with my purchase.
I ordered a set for my sister for Christmas. My mom liked them so much she asked me to order some for her as well.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the headbands comfortable and good value for the price, praising the quality relative to cost.
Reviewers frequently praise the large selection of cute patterns and colors included in the set.
A common complaint is that the headbands are too tight or too small, especially for larger heads, causing discomfort or headaches.
Some reviewers report the opposite fit problem, saying the headbands are too loose or too long and slide off.
A few reviewers mention receiving fewer pieces than the advertised count.
